tasks.description: Bind the accepted single Storage batch helper to a service-only account maintenance route.
constraints: Local, scoped integration and fixtures. Exact unified Git diff in JSON; controller applies and verifies. No stage/deployment, scheduled jobs, UI, real deletion test, trigger invoking actual service or new account.delete user endpoint.

Add internal POST /internal/account-deletions/<owner UUID>/storage only. Reuse the exact established service secret authentication pattern in plants-api for internal maintenance (legacy service bearer or configured service apikey). Resolve before public Auth middleware, reject unauthorized before any RPC/Storage, validate canonical owner UUID, reject query/body-provided paths and scope operation to the accepted runAccountStoragePurge helper. Private no-store for all recognized attempts, not_found maps to 404, retryable failure to 503 without raw IDs/paths. Test established internal paths remain unchanged.

Forward 064 grants only service_role execute on read_account_deletion_storage_work_plan(uuid). Keep 060 writer and detailed 061/062 private, no table grants. Use an explicit migration marker in existing pgTAP so historical 063-only tests still check private behavior, updated tests verify service-only scope. Deno mocked route tests verify access priority, no work on bad auth/owner/body, valid exact helper result and retries. Keep T082/T083 open; scheduling and actual DB/Auth purge separate.
